title: Introduction to Information Technology
desc: Fundamental computing concepts, hardware architecture, operating systems, and digital foundations.

title: C Programming
desc: Structured problem solving, memory pointers, dynamic allocation, structures, and file I/O in C.

title: Digital Logic
desc: Boolean algebra, combinational circuits, flip-flops, registers, counters, and digital circuit design.

title: Mathematics I (Calculus)
desc: Functions, limits, differential calculus, integral calculus, and multivariable applications.

title: Physics
desc: Electromagnetism, semiconductors, optics, quantum theory, and solid-state device principles.

title: Discrete Structure
desc: Set theory, graph theory, propositional logic, trees, relations, and combinatorics for computation.

title: Object-Oriented Programming (C++)
desc: Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, templates, operator overloading, and STL in C++.

title: Microprocessor
desc: 8085/8086 microprocessors, assembly language, memory interfacing, and I/O peripheral controllers.

title: Mathematics II (Linear Algebra)
desc: Matrices, vectors, eigenvalues, linear transformations, and systems of linear equations.

title: Statistics I
desc: Descriptive statistics, probability theory, random variables, and probability distributions.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
desc: Stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, graphs, sorting algorithms, hashing, and complexity analysis.

title: Numerical Method
desc: Numerical root finding, polynomial interpolation, numerical differentiation, integration, and ODEs.

title: Computer Architecture
desc: Instruction cycle, ALU, memory hierarchy, cache design, pipelining, and RISC/CISC architecture.

title: Computer Graphics
desc: Rasterization, Bresenham algorithms, 2D/3D transformations, projections, and illumination models.

title: Statistics II
desc: Sampling theory, hypothesis testing, ANOVA, linear regression analysis, and chi-square tests.

title: Theory of Computation
desc: Deterministic & non-deterministic automata (DFA/NFA), regular grammars, PDA, Turing machines, and NP-completeness.

title: Computer Networks
desc: OSI/TCP-IP models, subnetting, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), transport layer (TCP/UDP), and DNS.

title: Operating Systems
desc: Process scheduling, thread synchronization, deadlocks, virtual memory management, and paging.

title: Database Management System (DBMS)
desc: Relational algebra, SQL, normalization (1NF-BCNF), ACID transactions, indexing, and recovery.

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
desc: Heuristic search (A*, Minimax), knowledge representation, expert systems, neural nets, and NLP basics.

title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms (DAA)
desc: Divide-and-conquer, greedy heuristics, dynamic programming, network flow, and complexity classes.

title: System Analysis and Design
desc: SDLC methodologies, agile development, UML modeling, sequence diagrams, and requirements analysis.

title: Cryptography
desc: Symmetric ciphers (AES, DES), RSA public key cryptography, SHA hashing, and zero-knowledge protocols.

title: Simulation and Modeling
desc: Continuous & discrete systems, Monte Carlo methods, Poisson processes, and model verification.

title: Web Technology
desc: Modern full-stack architecture, HTTP protocols, asynchronous client-server APIs, DOM, and web standards.

title: Elective I (Image Processing)
desc: Digital image transforms, spatial filtering, edge detection, segmentation, and feature extraction.

title: Software Engineering
desc: Architectural patterns, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, quality assurance, and project estimation.

title: Compiler Design and Construction
desc: Lexical analysis (Lex), parsing (Yacc/Bison), syntax-directed translation, symbol tables, and code optimization.

title: E-Governance
desc: Digital public infrastructure, e-governance maturity models, cybersecurity policy, and identity management.

title: NET Centric Computing
desc: C#, .NET runtime environment, asynchronous programming, ASP.NET Web APIs, and Entity Framework.

title: Technical Writing
desc: Engineering reports, research methodology, scientific documentation, and professional communication.

title: Elective II (Applied Logic)
desc: First-order logic, modal logics, automated theorem proving, and formal hardware/software verification.

title: Advanced Java Programming
desc: Java Enterprise APIs, concurrent multi-threading, Spring Framework, servlets, and distributed sockets.

title: Data Warehousing and Data Mining
desc: ETL pipelines, star schemas, OLAP cubes, association rule mining (Apriori), and cluster analysis.

title: Principles of Management
desc: Organizational behavior, strategic planning, team leadership, risk assessment, and tech business management.

title: Project Work
desc: Comprehensive engineering capstone project: system architecture, sprint execution, and defense.

title: Elective III (Network Security)
desc: Firewalls, IDS/IPS, TLS/SSL protocols, network forensics, threat modeling, and ethical hacking.

title: Advanced Database
desc: Distributed databases, NoSQL engines, query optimization, transaction concurrency, and object-oriented DBs.

title: Internship
desc: Full-time professional industry internship solving production software engineering and AI problems.

title: Elective IV (Cloud Computing)
desc: Virtualization, cloud architectures (AWS/GCP), microservices, container orchestration, and serverless.

title: Elective V (Deep Learning)
desc: Backpropagation, CNN architectures, Recurrent Networks, Attention mechanisms, and Transformers.
